scripts.report: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report
scripts.test:api: npm run reset-db && npx playwright test --project=api
scripts.test:api:ci: npm run reset-db && (json-server db.json --port 3000 &) && wait-on http://localhost:3000/users && playwright test --project=api
scripts.test:full: concurrently -k -s first "npm run mock-server" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/users && playwright test"
